### 6. Financial Risk Factors

Despite the strong financial performance, the debt-to-equity ratio of 7.255 warrants attention. While the company has a significant net cash position, a high debt-to-equity ratio can sometimes signal higher financial risk. However, given the substantial cash flows and profitability, the company appears well-equipped to manage its debt obligations.
